reviews.title: Great product / assistance
reviews.comment: Excellent product.  Customer service was very supportive in choosing the right products for my needs.  Very friendly and knowledgeable, helped me buy several parts which resulted in an amazing computer.  The agent who assisted me over the phone was phenomenal, and installation in store was done quickly with no issues.  I stay with best buy for consistent results, and they never let me down!
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Great board for a wonderful price.
reviews.comment:
Exactly what you would expect from Gigabyte. Quality build, excellent overall look, packaging and included materials were above expectations, runs well. 

I'm in the middle of a complete new build (first one in about 15 years) and wanted to go top of the line. I know there is a huge industry push for AI this and that as well as "x3d enhancements and specialized" but truth of the matter is that is 90% software which will trickle down. I just enjoyed the massive discount on a top-tier board.
reviews.author: OllieQ

reviews.title: Great features
reviews.comment: This motherboard is incredible. The build quality is top-tier, BIOS is clean and responsive, and the connectivity is loaded with future-proof features like Wi-Fi 7 and tons of USB ports. VRMs stay cool even under heavy loads and DDR5 support is flawless. Great choice for any high-end AM5 build.
